_doc: POI dungeon mechanics tuning (ADR-0018, docs/POI_AUTHORING.md). Distances in metres, times in seconds, noise = Stimuli loudness (metres at which a normal listener just hears it; >= 20 also feeds the heat map). Yields are items handed over by a crouched disarm (poi.disarm_trap); 'salvage' is what a sprung trap still gives.

ambush._doc: Grouped (held) sleepers ignore ordinary noise, light and proximity until a trigger of their group fires; then they wake one after another, alerted to the player. Only these sound kinds within wake_radius wake them early.

guardian._doc: Guardians spawn this many infected tiers above their roll (normal -> Seeded -> Bloomed).

shotgun._doc: Damage falls off linearly from 'damage' at 'near' to 0 at 'far' for bodies the cone of 'cone_deg' (half angle) from the muzzle touches (a body counts as 0.3 m wide, so point-blank it hits anyone in front of the barrels); the wire pulls the trigger pull_seconds after it is caught.

padlock._doc: Breakable lock cues on locked doors: hit points per kind (deadbolts and bolts cannot be broken off; bash the door).
